name: Hikma Health Inc
mission: Hikma Health creates free and open source digital health solutions for clinics caring for refugees, migrants, and low-income patients.
theoryOfChange: Hikma Health, a US-based 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, outlines its strategic framework through its 'Our Approach' section on the About Us page, detailing how it aims to achieve positive outcomes at individual, institutional, and systemic levels by deploying its digital health solutions through clinical partners. The organization also utilizes an 'implementation science framework' to understand the real-world application and effectiveness of its system across various clinical and cultural settings, conducting feasibility studies and effectiveness trials. Furthermore, Hikma Health's Health & Environmental Record System (HERS) provides data analytics and modeling tools to empower data-driven decision-making at individual, clinic, population, and environmental levels. This system integrates health and environmental data to identify at-risk patients and employs predictive analytics to forecast disease outbreaks, resource needs, and intervention opportunities, thereby demonstrating a structured approach to measuring and tracking impact.
scoreSummary: Hikma Health Inc shows strong alignment and moderate impact.

In FY2025 filings, the organization reported a <cite id="1">100.0% program expense Ratio</cite> on total revenue of <cite id="2">$70,494 in FY2025</cite>. The charity's primary operations center on deploying open-source electronic health record (EHR) platforms and health data tools in crisis-affected regions. According to organizational reporting, its digital systems have reached <cite id="3">1,300,000 patients through partner organizations</cite> across regions including <cite id="3">Lebanon, Syria, and Nicaragua</cite>. Financially, the charity maintains a substantial reserve buffer, holding <cite id="1">26.0 months of working capital</cite> to support ongoing software maintenance and partner deployments. Revenue has shown early-stage growth from $53,989 in FY2022 to $250,749 in FY2024, though year-to-year funding remains inherently volatile for this emerging organization.
